name: labs/czbiohub-sf__reglo-icc-pump-control
title: Masterflex Ismatec Reglo ICC peristaltic pump
intro: Masterflex Ismatec Reglo ICC peristaltic pump, adapted from czbiohub-sf/reglo-icc-pump-control. It reads `max_flow_rate`, `running`, `channel_count`, `pump_address` and 4 more; sets `tubing_id`; runs `pump` and `stop_pump`. `pump`: run a pump at a declared flow rate for a declared duration or volume in a declared direction, reporting the volume moved. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
